verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's homepage claims company balances yield 100% of the CDI with daily liquidity. That is a first-party interest-bearing offering with a stated benchmark-linked rate, but it rests on a single marketing line. It does not document accrual or crediting mechanics, whether this is an account feature or a sweep into an investment product, or who keeps any spread. missing for 10: documented rate mechanics (accrual, crediting, tax treatment), explicit disclosure of spread retention, account-vs-sweep product structure, API/docs coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, idle balances can earn — interest-bearing accounts or documented sweep options, with the rate mechanics and who keeps the spread spelled out

citations.quote: Your company's money yielding 100% of the CDI with daily liquidity.
